name: certificate_of_quality
description: Extract the requested certificate-level identifiers and the characteristic results listed under each batch. Preserve every value exactly as printed in the source PDF.

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Company name: the issuing company shown in the certificate header or footer (for example, Contoso Polymers), not the recipient or packaging-group name.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country: the country in the issuing company's address or footer (for example, United States), not the state or city.

fields.name: reference_code
fields.description: Reference Code: the exact value printed next to Certificate No.; do not use the order, shipment, customer, or invoice number.

fields.name: issued_on
fields.description: Issued On: the exact date printed next to Issue Date, preserving the source formatting.

fields.name: order_number
fields.description: Order Number: the complete exact value printed next to Order Ref., including any date after a slash; do not use a batch, shipment, customer, or invoice number.

fields.name: consignment_number
fields.description: Consignment Number: the complete exact value printed next to Shipment Ref., including any date after a slash; do not use the order or customer number.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Client ID: the exact value printed next to Customer Code.

records.name: test_results
records.description: One record for every characteristic row in every batch table. For each row, copy the lot number from the nearest preceding Batch (Lot) line. Include only the requested fields below; ignore Min and Max columns and other batch metadata such as expiry date, quantity, and manufacture date.

fields.name: lot_number
fields.description: Lot Number: the exact value immediately following Batch (Lot) for the batch containing this characteristic row; do not include the expiry date, quantity, or manufacture date.

fields.name: characteristic
fields.description: Characteristic: the exact text from the Property column for this row, such as Melt Flow Index (190C/2.16kg), Density, or Contamination (Fluorescence).

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit: the exact value from the Unit column for this characteristic row.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Result: the exact value from the Result column for this characteristic row, including comparison symbols, spaces, punctuation, and trailing zeroes; never substitute Min or Max.

fields.name: test_method
fields.description: Test Method: the exact value from the Test Method column for this characteristic row.
